_note: Maize placeholders with PHENOLOGY ONLY re-based on the Greeley CO trials (2008-2011): gdd_anthesis 830 from the two observed R1 dates (792 and 859 GDD), other stage thresholds scaled by the same factor, season ends by killing frost (-2 C) or 1800 GDD. Do NOT use outside a cool, high-altitude site; all other values are unverified placeholders (see maize.json).

_provenance.gdd_dev_end: derived:scaled from gdd_anthesis by the same factor as maize.json
_provenance.gdd_mid_start: derived:scaled from gdd_anthesis by the same factor as maize.json
_provenance.gdd_late_start: derived:scaled from gdd_anthesis by the same factor as maize.json
_provenance.gdd_maturity: derived:set above any reachable GDD at Greeley so killing frost ends the season
